title: feat: add MiniMax H3
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds paid-only `minimax-h3` through fal route `minimax/h3/text-to-video`, with no aliases, fallback, or Pollinations GPU.
- Exposes five-second 16:9 text-to-video with synchronized audio at 480p, 768p, and 2K.
- Bills exact fal rates through resolution variants: $0.05/s, $0.08/s, and $0.13/s (multiplier 1).
- Uses the generic durable generation coordinator and R2 cache; no model-specific retry storage.

Validation:
- Direct-provider and authenticated local E2E passed every resolution and default behavior.
- 2K survived a deliberate client disconnect; the identical retry joined the same job, returned the cached result, and billed exactly once at $0.65.
- Verified H.264/24 FPS video, stereo AAC, visual quality, permission and error paths, cache hits, and a 2/2 concurrent burst.
- Focused Gen tests, registry pricing invariants/snapshot, brand-logo check, Biome, and typecheck pass.

4K is intentionally excluded.

gist.headline: Five Seconds, Full Sound
gist.blurb: A new video flower has opened in the paid garden: MiniMax H3 makes short 16:9 clips with synchronized audio. Polli checked the cache, the retry path, and the stereo soundtrack; the bees remain suspiciously thorough.
gist.summary: Added paid-only `minimax-h3` video generation through fal's `minimax/h3/text-to-video` route, producing five-second 16:9 clips with synchronized audio at 480p, 768p, or 2K and exact per-second resolution pricing.
gist.impact: Developers can request MiniMax H3 videos at $0.05/s for 480p, $0.08/s for 768p, or $0.13/s for 2K; durable jobs and R2 caching let identical retries reuse the same completed result and bill once.
gist.visual_concept: Depict MiniMax H3 as a cozy retro film-and-sound workstation: a five-second film strip emerges from a CRT video terminal while musical waveform sprites travel alongside it. Polli, wearing tiny director headphones, guides the clip toward three labeled resolution canisters—480p, 768p, and 2K—while code-plants and flowers grow around a warm R2-style storage chest, representing durable cached generations and retry-safe reuse.
